integrity: An unrestricted algebraic proof is supplied. A standalone finite-field checker was replayed from the package directory and its complete output recorded; independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the additive commutator of ordered rank-one idempotents in two-by-two matrix rings over finite fields, not higher matrix dimensions or arbitrary coefficient rings. Earlier determinant and existence criteria are credited; historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Exact commutator fibers of two rank-one idempotents over finite fields
